'''Adar 4 (April 16)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{Ne|998}} - The ''[[Spray]]'' arrives at [[Whitebridge]]. At The [[Wayfarers' Rest]], [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] hear of [[Logain Ablar]]'s capture. Outside, they encounter a [[Fade]]. Thom battles it, as the boys run. They set off down the [[Caemlyn Road]].
